source.post_text:
Zach Lowe says the Lakers are TRAPPED after the Walker Kessler trade and may be forced to trade Austin Reaves

“There’s no question that they overpaid for him [Walker Kessler] and are now trapped with this team and have to figure out: either this is the team or is there a way to pivot by trading Austin Reaves down the line or something like that. They are out of tradeable assets because of the Walker Kessler deal.”

replies.text: Kessler does lock them into a certain build and the asset cost was steep, but pairing him with Luka still leaves room to see if the fit works before forcing a Reaves move. Feels early to call it a full trap.
replies.author: decoy
